notes: Executable Morey-Saint-Denis vineyard-management law from the controlling 2011 ministry specification currently referenced by INAO. The two-year Guyot-double cordon-establishment exception remains unmodeled rather than generalized.

constraints.notes: Rows require >=9,000 vines/ha, <=1.25 m row spacing and >=0.50 m vine spacing; foule uses >0.50 m spacing and stakes. White cordon pruning is capped at 10 buds and white Guyot simple at 8; ordinary red pruning is capped at 8 buds for the encoded systems. Trellised canopy height is >=0.6 times row spacing. Parcel crop load is <=10,500 kg/ha white and <=9,000 kg/ha red. Irrigation is prohibited. The 20% dead/missing-vine trigger feeds the national D.645-4 proportional-yield remedy.
